cards.explanation: The answer is His Spirit, friends. The LORD says, "And afterward, I will pour out My Spirit on all people." (Joel 2:28) Pour is a big word. I think of a whole bowl of chocolate chips going into the dough, not a sprinkle here and there.
The answer is all, friends! The LORD says, "…I will pour out My Spirit on all people." (Joel 2:28) Not some people, not a few people. ALL. That's a wide-open bakery door.

The answer is False. The LORD says, "Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions." (Joel 2:28) Daughters are right there next to the sons. Everybody gets a turn at the dough.

The answer is His menservants and maidservants, bakers. The LORD says, "Even on My menservants and maidservants, I will pour out My Spirit in those days." (Joel 2:29) Servants are the ones you'd expect to be last in line. Here they get the Spirit poured out on them too. I love that, friends.

The answer is the great and awesome Day of the LORD, friends. The LORD says, "The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD." (Joel 2:31) The signs come first, then the Day.

The answer is everyone who calls on the name of the LORD, bakers. The verse says, "And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved…" (Joel 2:32) Everyone. Anyone who calls. That's a promise worth putting in a cookie box.

The answer is remnant, friends! The verse says there will be deliverance "…among the remnant called by the LORD." (Joel 2:32) A remnant is what's left, like the last few cookies in the bottom of the box. And these ones are called by the LORD.
